name: studer-a800-warm-glue
description: Standalone single-plugin starting point for the UADx Studer A800 = the doc's DEFAULT warm/glue recipe (REPRO / 456 / 15 IPS / NAB / Cal +6 / Auto Cal ON / Noise OFF). Gentle Input (3 dB) for an LF head-bump + tape compression without the upper-mid edge driven tape adds. Tape measurably DARKENS (centroid −341 on our drum bus) — it warms/glues, it does not brighten. Use as the base for warmth/glue on a stem, drum bus, or 2-bus; raise input_level to taste (stop when the top spits). Built 2026-06-03.
intended_for: a stem / drum bus / mix bus that wants tape warmth + glue (LF weight, gentle transient rounding) with no harshness — the neutral default before you push it
plugin_build: uaudio_studer_a800.vst3 (UADx native — renders headless; never the UAD ….component twin)
notes: GAIN-STAGE FIRST: the A800 is a −12 dBFS = 0 VU plugin. A near-0 dBFS source slams it; a −18-referenced feed under-drives ~6 dB. Set input_gain_db (or pre-trim) so peaks land near 0 VU, then drive input_level to taste.

DRIVE to taste: raise input_level until you see only ~1–3 dB of transient reduction (crest drop) on the loudest hits; STOP the moment the top starts to spit (that is rising 3rd harmonic = new harshness). Trim output_level to gain-match.

VERIFY: centroid + tilt should go DOWN (LF lift + HF softening), not a 2–5 kHz rise; crest should not collapse (glue ≠ squash). measure-spectrum / measure-loudness / measure-microdynamics / check-clipping.

VARIANTS: tighter/punchy → 30 IPS + GP9/900 + cal 9 and push Input; darker/tame harshness → drop repro_hf_eq (most direct), less Input, or 30 IPS; fat/dark → 7.5 IPS. See docs/vst/studer-a800.md §7 decision table.
If too dull, do NOT add hf_record_eq / HF Driver (re-adds brightness + changes the saturation) — lighten drive or move toward 30 IPS / CCIR.
